message.content:
An editorial illustration features a silhouette of a man with a shadowed face, wearing a dark fedora and a light-colored, knee-length trench coat. The figure is positioned centrally against a black background. The man's right gloved hand is visible, pulling open the side of his coat to reveal the interior. Instead of a lining, the inside of the coat contains lit wooden shelves holding several red, bean-shaped organic objects. These objects are arranged in pairs on the shelves.

The top of the image contains text in white and red. The masthead "TEMPO" is partially visible behind the figure's hat. On the left, text reads "Prabowo Berburu Partai Gurem H.28". On the right, "Jumpalitan Menggenjot Pasar Kendaraan Listrik H.74". Below the masthead, further text includes "7-13 AGUSTUS 2023", "RP 50.000", and a barcode. The main headline on the lower left reads "KOMPLOTAN PENJAJA GINJAL KAMBOJA" in bold white capital letters. A paragraph below details an Asian illegal kidney trade syndicate using social media and involving immigration officers, ending with "H.60".
